description: You are a security systems integrator commissioning a new VMS installation for a retail facility. The facility's security architect has defined a tiered recording policy based on camera location risk level. Log in to the Nx Witness Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin / Admin1234!). Configure the recording schedule for each camera according to the following tier specifications — all schedules must cover all seven days of the week: 'Parking Lot Camera' (Tier 1 — high-risk exterior): continuous recording, always-on mode, 25 fps, high quality stream. 'Entrance Camera' (Tier 1 — high-risk entry point): continuous recording, always-on mode, 15 fps, high quality stream. 'Server Room Camera' (Tier 2 — interior restricted area): motion-triggered recording only (metadata and low quality), 10 fps, low quality stream, to conserve storage. After saving all three configurations, create a monitoring layout named 'Security Operations Center' that displays all three cameras simultaneously.
